lines.trans: We all dream about having a happy ending.
Unfortunately.
In real life it does not always happen.
And not for everyone.
While someone else thinks their happy ending has already arrived.
That the happy ending is already here.
It looks like we are going to have a baby.
And to someone else it only seems that way.

words.gram: present, 3rd person singular, imperfective; used as a parenthetical word

lines.trans: Keep fighting for your happy ending.
And now for an important announcement.
From now on, a new waiter will be working on your shift.
Maxim Lavrov.

наступить.gloss: to come (of time); to step on

meanings.en: to come, to set in (night, winter, a moment)
meanings.note: Наступила ночь = night has fallen. Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'ступить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come (of time); to step on', paired with 'наступать'.

Наступить на + accusative. Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'ступить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come (of time); to step on', paired with 'наступать'.
